equivalentQueryQualification.originalSql: SELECT f.quantity,r.quantity,l.quantity-f.quantity+r.quantity FROM order_lines l JOIN fulfillments f ON f.line_id=l.id JOIN returns r ON r.line_id=l.id WHERE f.quantity<l.quantity
